name: io.github.VisualSentinel/mcp-server
title: Visual Sentinel
description: Website monitoring for AI assistants. Visual Sentinel catches pages that look broken even when the site is up. Five tools (DNS, SSL, speed, website check, service health) need no account; twelve account tools need an API key (Business and Agency plans).

environmentVariables.name: VS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Visual Sentinel API key for the twelve account tools (Business and Agency plans). Create one at https://visualsentinel.com/settings/api-keys. The five public tools work without it.
